title: Borel representative of the n-density of an s-finite measure
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ and let μ be an s-finite Borel measure on ℝ^N (for instance a σ-finite one such as μ_V). Then there is a Borel measurable g : ℝ^N → [0, ∞] such that g(x) = t for every x ∈ ℝ^N and t ∈ [0, ∞] with HasDensity n μ x t, i.e. with μ(B_ρ(x))/(ω_n ρ^n) → t as ρ ↓ 0 (closed balls B_ρ(x), ω_n = unitBallVolume n).
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) [SFinite μ], ∃ g : Euclidean N → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g ∧ ∀ (x : Euclidean N) (t : ℝ≥0∞), HasDensity n μ x t → g x = t
